Frequently Asked Questions

How old is OG Anunoby?

OG Anunoby is 29 years old.

Where was OG Anunoby born?

OG Anunoby was born in London, United Kingdom.

When was OG Anunoby born?

OG Anunoby was born on July 17, 1997.

How tall is OG Anunoby?

OG Anunoby is 6-7 (201 cm) tall.

How much does OG Anunoby weigh?

OG Anunoby weighs 240 lbs (108 kg).

Is OG Anunoby in the Hall of Fame?

OG Anunoby is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was OG Anunoby drafted?

OG Anunoby was drafted by Toronto Raptors, 1st round (23rd pick, 23rd overall), 2017 NBA Draft.

What position does OG Anunoby play?

Small Forward and Power Forward.

What is OG Anunoby's net worth?

OG Anunoby has made at least $138,030,302 playing professional basketball.

How much does OG Anunoby make?

OG Anunoby made $39,568,966 in 2026.

How many rings does OG Anunoby have?

OG Anunoby has won 2 championships.

What is OG Anunoby's Instagram account?

OG Anunoby is on Instagram at oanunoby.

What schools did OG Anunoby attend?

OG Anunoby attended Jefferson City in Jefferson City, Missouri and Indiana.
